title: feat(explore): expand incomplete reasons for buckets in events-timeseries
body:
Replace the existing singular incomplete bucket reason with:
- NOT_ELAPSED 
- INGESTION_PENDING 
- OUTSIDE_RETENTION 

Bucket reason is based on the buckets start and end vs `complete_through` timestamp, retention period, and current time.
